name: cleanroom_enzgfm_outer_meta_exposure_audit_v1
finding: The clean2023 development associations used for Gate A/B overlap 69.2%-90.0% of exact outer test pairs and 73.0%-92.9% of outer test proteins across the five frozen cells. Although no outer benchmark file was explicitly used by Gate A/B and final per-cell weights would have been reinitialized, this is substantial meta-selection exposure and is not accepted as an independent outer protocol.
decision: Invalidate v1 as an independent outer selection protocol before evaluation. Use v2 nested selection: representation/reaction choices are selected only from each cell's train_pairs via inner entity-disjoint folds, then retrain on all cell train pairs and evaluate test once.
